m: अपर—वल्लभ m. N. of a people, MBh.
अपर—वर्षा f. pl. the latter part of the rains.
अ-पर—वत् mfn. having nothing following, ŚBr.
अपर—वत् See 1. अ-पर.
a: अपरवत् — a. Like what follows.

m: अपर—वेदनीय n. (Karman) manifesting itself at a subsequent period, Dharmas. 132
अपरवोज्झित mfn. free from dispute, undisturbed, undisputed.
अ-पर-योग mfn. without another addition, unmixed, Āpast.
अपरेण ind. (with acc.) behind, west, to the west of KātyŚr.

a: अपरेद्युः — adv. On the following day Ms. 3. 187.

m: अपरे-द्युस् ind. on the following day, MaitrS. &c.
अपरे-द्युस् See 2. अपर.
अपरेतरा f. opposite to or other than the west, the east, L.
अ-पर्हाण = अ-परिहाण, q.v.
अ-परिभाषित mfn. not explicitly mentioned, Bālar.
अ-परिभक्ष m. not passing over another at a meal, Lāṭy.
अ-परिभिन्न mfn. not broken into small pieces, not crumbled, ŚBr.
अ-परिभोगम् ind. without being eaten, Divyāv.
अ-परिभ्रश्यमान mfn., not escaping, Kām.
अ-परिणाम m. (√ नम्), unchangeableness.
a: अपरिणामः — Unchangeableness; ˚दर्शिन् not prudent, improvident.

m: अ-परिणाम—दर्शिन् mfn. not providing for a change, improvident.
अ-परिणामिन् mfn. unchanging.
अ-परिणीता f. an unmarried woman.
a: अपरिणीता — An unmarried girl.

a: अपरिणयः — Celibacy.

m: अ-परिणयन n. (√ नी), non-marriage, celibacy.

v: pu॰ aBAve na॰ ta॰ । pariSezABAve iyattArAhitye । na॰ ba॰ । iyattASUnye tri॰ ।
m: अ-परिशेष mfn. not leaving a remainder, all-surrounding, all-enclosing, Sāṅkhyak.
a: अपरिशेष — a. Not leaving a remainder; all-surrounding, all-pervading; ˚षं ज्ञानं Sāṅ. K. --षः Absence of remainder or limit.

m: अ-परिश्लथम् ind. not loosely, very firmly, Uttarar.
अ-परिश्रित n. not an enclosure, TāṇḍBr.
अ-परिबाध mfn. v.l. for अ-परिवाह.
अ-परिच्छादित mfn. id.

v: tri॰ na paricCadoyasya aprASastye na॰ ba॰ । apakfzwavastrAdyupakaraRayukte daridre ।
m: अ-परिच्छद mfn. (√ छद्), without retinue, unprovided with necessaries, Mn. viii, 405.
a: अपरिच्छद — a. Poor, destitute.

s: aparicCannaM
tri, paricCadaSUnyaM । paripUrvvaCadaDAtoH karttari kte naYsamAsaH ॥
v: tri॰ paricCannaH parizkftaH na॰ ta॰ । aparipkfte, mArjjanaSudDyAdirahite ।
m: अ-परिच्छन्न mfn. uncovered, unclothed.

v: pu॰ aBAvArTe na॰! paricCedABAve iyattABAve । na॰ ba॰ । iyattASUnye tri॰ ।
m: अ-परिच्छेद m. want of distinction or division
want of discrimination, Śāk.; want of judgement; continuance.
a: अपरिच्छेदः — 1 Want of distinction or division. --2 Want of order or arrangement. --3 Want of judgment. --4 Continuance, connection.

s: aparicCinnaM

tri, (pari + Cid + ktva tato naYsamAsaH .) paricCedarahitaM । asIma । vahirantaraSUnyaM । yaTA, -- “kiYca paricCinnasya nIqe pakzyAderiva praveSo Bavet tava tvanAvftatvAt aparicCinnatvena vahirantaraBedo nAsti kutaH praveSaH” । iti SrIDarasvAmI ॥
v: na॰ na paricCinnaH । iyattArahite niHsImani kUwasTe cEtanyAtmake brahmaRi “tadetadbrahmApUrvvamanaparamanantamiti vf॰ u॰ SrutyA tasyAntarAhityoktestaTAtvam iyattArahitamAtre tri॰ “jagatyaparyyAptetyAdi” mAGavyAKyAyAmaparyyAptaH aparicCanna” iti malli॰ ।
m: अ-परिच्छिन्न mfn. without interval or division, uninterrupted, continuous
connected
unlimited
undistinguished.
a: अपरिच्छिन्न — a. 1 Undiscerned, undistinguished. --2 Continuous, connected, without interval or separation.

m: अ-परिचलित mfn. unmoved, immovable, Śiś.
अ-परिचयिन् mfn. (√ 2. चि), having no acquaintances, misanthropic.
a: अपरिचयिन्, --परिचेय — a. Having no acquaintance; unsocial, misanthropic.

m: अ-परिचेय mfn. unsociable.

v: tri॰ pari + ci--kta na॰ ta॰ । anuSIlitaBinne, pUrvvamajYAte ca ।
m: अ-परिचित mfn. unacquainted with, unknown to.
अ-परिगण्य mfn. incalculable.

v: tri॰ na॰ ta॰ । jYAtaBinne, aprApte ca ।
m: अ-परिगत mfn. unobtained, unknown, Kād.

v: tri॰ na॰ ta॰ । asvIkfte, agfhIte, ajYAte ca

m: अ-परिग्राह्य mfn. unfit or improper to be accepted, not to be taken.

v: pu॰ aBAve na॰ ta॰ । parigrahABAve, pAtaYjalokte yamaBede ca yaTA “ahiMsAsatyAsteyabrahmacaryyAparigrahA yamAH” “sU॰ tatrAparigrahI nAma dehayAtrAnirvAhakAtiriktaBogasADanaDanAdyanaNgIkAraH । tasya Palamapi tatrEva darSitam yaTA “aparigrahasTEryye janmakaTantAsaMboGaH” aparigrahaSIlasya tatsTEryye sati kiMrUpaM janma kiMprakArakaM, kiMhetukaM, kiMPalakam, kimavasAnamiti SarIrasyApi parigrahaviroDinI jijYAsA Bavati SarIrasyApi parigrAhyatvAviSezAtkaTaM tatparigraho na syAditi jijYAsAvaSyamBAvAt । tataH kAryyakaraRasaMbanDAt puruzasyAjYasya janma devanaratiryyakatvaprakAram । kleSakarmmahetukaM, duHKEkaPalakam, puruzatattvAvasAnamityAcAryyAdAgamataSca niScitya adehaH sannaparigrahayamasya paramAM kAzWAmanuBavatItyarTaH” iti tadvf॰ । “loBasya purataH ke'mI? satyAsteyAparigrahA” iti pra॰ ca॰ । nAsti dehayAtrAnirvvAhakavyatiriktasya parigrahaH saMgraho yasya । parivrAjake “nirASIraparigraha” iti gItA । tasya ca kOpInAdiparigrahaRe'pi tasya SarIrayAtrAnirvAhakatvAnna kzatiH “kOpInAcCAdanArTaM hi vAsovE biBfyAdyatiH । yogasamBAraBedAMSca gfhRIyAt pAduke taTeti” smftO tatparigrahaviDAnAt ।
m: अ-परिग्रह m. not including Comm. on TPrāt.
non-acceptance, renouncing (of any possession besides the necessary utensils of ascetics), Jain.
deprivation, destitution, poverty
अ-परिग्रह mfn. destitute of possession
destitute of attendants or of a wife, Kum. i, 54.
a: अपरिग्रह — a. Without possessions or belongings, attendants &c; quite destitute, as in निराशीरपरिग्रहः --हः 1 Non-acceptance, rejection, renunciation, one of the several kinds of yamas (mental restraints) stated in Yoga Śāstra by Patañjali. --2 Destitution, poverty.

m: अ-परिहाण or अ-पर्हाण n. the state of not being deprived of anything, KauṣBr.
अ-परिहार्य mfn. id., Gaut. &c.

s: aparihAryyaM

tri, (pari + hf + karmmaRi Ryat, tato naYsamAsaH .) apariharaRIyaM । atyAjyaM । yaTA, “jAtasya hi Druvo mftyurDruvaM janma mftasya ca । tasmAdaparihAryye'rTe na tvaM Socitumarhasi” ॥ iti SrIBagavadgItA ॥
v: tri॰ na pariharttumarhati Sakyate vA hf--Ryat । pariharttumayogye, pariharttumaSakye ca ।

m: अ-परिहीण-कालम् ind. without loss of time, at once, Bālar.
अ-परिही-यमाण mfn. not being omitted (˚णं √ कृ, ‘to supply deficiencies’), MBh.

v: tri॰ na pariharttuM Sakyate hf--SakyAdyarTe karmmaRi anIyar । pariharttumaSakye, pariharttumayogye ca ।
m: अ-परिहरणीय mfn. not to be avoided, inevitable
not to be abandoned or lost
not to be degraded.
a: अपरिहरणीय, अपरिहार्य — a. 1 Inevitable. --2 Not to be abandoned. --3 Not to be degraded.

m: अ-परिहित n. an unworn or clean garment, Āpast.
अ-परिह्वृत mfn. unafflicted, not endangered, RV. (cf. Pāṇ. vii, 2, 32.)
a: अपरिह्वृत — a. Ved. Not endangered or afflicted; straightforward.

m: अ-परिजात mfn. not fully born, born prematurely, ĀśvGṛ.
अ-परिजीर्ण mfn. undigested, Suśr.

v: na॰ aBAve na॰ ta॰ । tattvavivakABAve । na॰ ba॰ । tacCUnye tri॰ ।

a: अपरिज्यानिः — f. Not losing; not growing old or decaying; इष्टापूर्तस्य˚ N. of a ceremony.

m: अ-परिकलित mfn. unknown, unseen.
अ-परिक्लिन्न mfn. not moist, not liquid, dry.

m: अ-परिक्रामम् ind. without going about, standing still, KātyŚr.

v: tri॰ nAsti parikramaH udyogoyasya । anudyukte । “jAnannapi ca kiM kuryyAdaSaktaScAparikrama iti” smftiH । paritaH kramaH kramaRam aBAvArTe na॰ ta॰ । paritaH kramaRABAve pu॰ । parigataH kramam na॰ ta॰ । kramAparigate aparapAwIke tri॰ ।
m: अ-परिक्रम mfn. not walking about, unable to walk round, R. ii, 63, 42.
a: अपरिक्रम — a. 1 Unable to walk round. --2 Not diligent.

m: अ-परिलोप m. non-loss
non-damage, RPrāt.
अ-परिलुप्त mfn. not invalidated, RPrāt., Sch.

v: na॰ aBAve na॰ ta॰ । parimARABAve iyattArAhitye na॰ ba॰ । tacCUnye tri॰ ।
m: अ-परिमाण mfn. without measure, immeasurable, immense
अ-परिमाण n. immeasurableness.
a: अपरिमाण, अपरिमित, अपरिमेय — a. Immeasurable, immense, unbounded.

v: tri॰ parimAtuM yogyaH na॰ ta॰ । parimAtumayogye iyattArahite ।
m: अ-परिमेय mfn. immeasurable, illimitable.
अपरिमितालिखित mfn. having an indefinite number of lines, ŚBr.; KātyŚr.

tri, (pari + mA + kta, tato naYsamAsaH .) parimARarahitaM । mAnatulAsaMKyASUnyaM । yaTA, -- “aparimitA DruvAstanuBfto yadi sarvvagatAstarhi na SAsyateti niyamo DruvanetaraTA” । iti SrutyaDyAyaH ।
m: अ-परिमित mfn. unmeasured, either indefinite or unlimited, AV.; ŚBr. &c.
अ-परिमित—धा ind. into an unlimited number of pieces or parts, MaitrUp.
अ-परिमित—गुण-गण mfn. of unbounded excellences.
अ-परिमित-कृत्वस् ind. innumerable times, TĀr.
अ-परिमित—विध (अपरिमित-), mfn. indefinitely multiplied, ŚBr.

puM, (pari + mlA + kta tasya natvaM, tato naYsamAsaH .) raktAmlAnavfkzaH । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥ mlAnirahite vAcyaliNgaH ॥ (nUtanaH । apariSuzkaH । nirmmalaH .)

m: अ-परिम्लान m. ‘not withering, not decaying’, the plant Gomphrena Globosa.
a: अपरिम्लान — a. Not fading, withering, or decaying. --नः N. of a plant (महासहावृक्ष) Gomphrena Globosa.

m: अ-परिम्लान-ललाटता f. the having an unwrinkled forehead (one of the 80 minor marks of a Buddha), Dharmas. 84.
अ-परिमोष m. not stealing, TS.

a: अपरिनिष्ठित — a. Not properly placed or established; ˚तस्योपदेशस्यान्याय्यं प्रकाशनं M. 1 not properly grounded.

s: aparipakvaM
tri, paripAkarahitaM । kiYcitpakvaM । paripUrvvapacaDAtoH karttari kte tasya vatve casya ca katve paripakvaM tato naYsamAsaH ॥

m: अ-परिपक्व mfn. not quite ripe (as fruits, or a tumour [Suśr.])
not quite mature.
अ-परिपर mfn. not going by a tortuous course, AV. xviii, 2, 46; MaitrS.
a: अपरिपर — a. Ved. Not going by a tortuous course.

m: अ-परिस्थान mfn. improper
अ-परिस्थान n. impropriety, Mālatīm.
अ-परिसंख्यान n. innumerableness, infinite difference, Nyāyas.
a: अपरिसंख्यानं — Infinity, innumerableness.

m: अ-परिसंख्येय mfn. innumerable, infinitely different, ib., Sch.

v: strI aBAve na॰ ta॰ । iyattABAve samAptyaBAve ca । na॰ ba॰ । tacCUnye tri॰ ।

m: अ-परिसमाप्तिक mfn. not ending, endless Comm. on BṛĀrUp.

v: pu॰ aBAve na॰ ta॰ । vistArABAve pracArABAve ca na॰ ba॰ । tacCUnye tri॰ ।
m: अ-परिसर mfn. non-contiguous, distant.
a: अपरिसर — a. 1 Not near, distant. --2 Not extensive, not current. --रः Absence of extent.
अपरिस्कंद — a. Motionless.

m: अ-परिस्कन्दम् ind. so as not to jump or leap about, Bhaṭṭ.
अ-परितोष mfn. unsatisfied, discontented, Śāk.
अ-परित्त (?), for अ-परीत्त (below), MaitrS.
अ-परित्यज्य mfn. = (or v.l. for) अ-परित्याज्य.
अ-परिवाद्य mfn. (√ वद्), not to be reprimanded, Gaut.
अ-परिवीत mfn. (√ व्ये), not covered, ŚBr.
अ-परिवर्गम् ind. without leaving out, uninterruptedly, completely, TS.; TBr.; ĀpŚr.
अ-परिवर्तनीय mfn. not to be exchanged.

v: tri॰ na parivftaH । anAcCAdite । paritovezwanarahite anAvfte kzetrAdO “tatrAparivftaM SasyaM vihiMsyuH paSavoyadIti” manuH kzetrAdyAvaraRaprakAro'pi tena darSitaH “vftiM tatra prakurvvIta yAmuzwronAvalokayet CidraYca vArayet rsavaM SvaSUkaramuKAnugamiti” tena tAdfSacCidrahInavaraRaSUnye'pi aparivftatvam asaMspfzwe ca “mahoBiraparIvfto vasati pracetAH” f॰ 2, 10, 3, aparIvfto'saMspfzwaH iti BA॰ vededIrGaH ।
m: अ-परिवृत mfn. not hedged in or fenced, Mn. & Gaut. (cf. अ-परीवृत.)
a: अपरिवृत — a. Not enclosed or fenced on all sides (as a field).

v: tri॰ pari + viza--karmmaRikta na॰ ta॰ । vezwanaSUnye avyApte । “UrjjayantyA aparivizwamAsyamiti” f॰ 2, 13, 8 । aparivizwaM malAdiBiravyAptamiti” BA॰ । vizwamAhArArTamupahftaM na॰ ta॰ । parivezanaSUnye BojaparinArTamanupaQOkite tri॰ ।
m: अ-परिविष्ट mfn. not enclosed, unbounded, RV. ii, 13, 8.
a: अपरिविष्ट — a. Ved. Not covered or enclosed (अव्याप्त, वेष्टनशून्य).

m: अ-परियाणि f. inability to walk about (used in execrations), Pāṇ. viii, 4, 29, Kāś.
a: अपरियाणि — [अ-परि˚] Not walking, about (used in curses only); see अप्रयाणी.

v: pu॰ aBAve na॰ ta॰ । mArjjanAdiSoDanasaMskArABAve । na॰ ba॰ । tacCUnye tri॰ ।
m: अ-परिष्कार m. want of polish or finish
coarseness, rudeness.

m: अ-परिष्कृत mfn. unpolished, unadorned, coarse.
a: अपरिष्कृत — a. Unpolished, unrefined, rude, coarse.

a: अपरिष्टिः — f. [रिष्टेर्हिसाया अभावः] Worship (पूजाया हिंसाहेतुकद्वेषशून्यत्वात्).

m: अपर्क्य-पृष्ठ m. a partic. Ekāha, ŚāṅkhŚr.

v: pu॰ apa + ruDa--BAve GaY । “bADane aBiprayAyamaBizuRvanti deSAnaparoDena” kAtyA॰ 24, 3, 31 ।
m: अप-रोध m. exclusion, prohibition (अन्- neg.), KātyŚr.
a: अपरोधः — Exclusion, prohibition.

m: अप-रोधुक mfn. detaining, hindering, MaitrS.
अप-रोध्य mfn. to be expelled or excluded from, TĀr.
अप-रोद्धृ m. one who keeps another off, a repeller, TS.
